purpose: Introduce the short-window linear approximation and its qualified accuracy before the stability-indicator study.
first_draft: A short-window linear approximation is used to analyze nonlinear and time-varying structural degradation while keeping the analysis tractable and suitable for online evaluation. Although the approximation may be inaccurate during brief intervals of rapid property change, it is typically accurate before and after these events and during periods of slowly evolving degradation.
